dedupe_keys.name: sugarloaf shoreline sfm monte carlo script and metadata template

description: The Sugarloaf shoreline team deposits an updated Monte Carlo script for checking structure-from-motion georeferencing in a Figshare Plus item that also contains its data-curation template. The own item metadata lists a small code archive under CC BY 4.0. The article says the script adapts an existing Metashape routine for version 1.6 and helps test positional accuracy of drone-derived coastal elevation products. A modeller can inspect this uncertainty step before comparing seasonal shoreline surfaces with erosion or flood-defence simulations. Coverage is the Sugarloaf Island survey workflow, although similar camera and GNSS projects may reuse the method. A caveat is that the script depends on Agisoft Metashape and project control points; repository metadata alone does not establish compatibility with later versions. The eight seasonal data deposits share a collection DOI. I read the own item manifest and article code statement without downloading the ZIP, running Metashape or checking resulting uncertainty. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
